# Hourglass Cosmetics

> > Luxury cruelty-free cosmetics brand featuring Ambient Lighting technology, vegan makeup brushes, and award-winning formulas including Unlocked Mascara, Vanish Concealer, and Voyeur eyeshadow collections.

Hourglass Cosmetics is a premium beauty brand known for innovative products like the Ambient Lighting Palette, Scattered Light Glitter Eyeshadow, and professional-grade PETA-approved Taklon bristle brushes. The site offers curated collections, gift sets, and a professional artist program.

## Key Topics

- Ambient Lighting technology
- Unlocked Instant Extensions Mascara
- Vanish Airbrush Concealer
- Voyeur Eyeshadow Stick
- Scattered Light Glitter Eyeshadow
- Vegan makeup brushes
- Cruelty-free cosmetics
- Ambient Lighting Palette
- Ambient Lighting Bronzer
- Ambient Lighting Blush
- Voyeur Waterproof Gel Eyeliner
- Professional Beauty Artist program
- Luxury cosmetics
- PETA-approved products
